override._why: A on Single Player gives a 'create a profile' dialog, then A the Name Profile wheel, but the next default press is Start, which opens the START MENU, and A there picks Main Menu, so the run loops back to the main menu. Only A presses are needed: ACCEPT (default name PROFILE) > Activate > Single Player > Campaign > ACCEPT > Normal > Equipment > the intro cinematic > gameplay. An A every 2 s works from any point in the loop; it runs to the end, as the main menu can take until about 110 s.
